title: How to Run Facebook Ads in Cameroon: Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners
author: Slim Biz
excerpt: Learn how to run Facebook Ads in Cameroon step by step. From creating your first campaign to targeting the right audience and managing your budget — this guide covers everything beginners need to know.
body:
Facebook Ads are one of the most powerful tools available to businesses in Cameroon. But many business owners are intimidated by the platform or waste money on poorly set up campaigns. This step-by-step guide will walk you through exactly how to run Facebook Ads in Cameroon, even if you have never done it before.

Step 1: Create a Facebook Business Page

Before you can run ads, you need a Facebook Business Page. This is separate from your personal profile. Go to Facebook, click Create, then Page, choose Business or Brand, and fill in your business details. Add a professional profile photo (your logo) and a cover image that represents your business clearly.

Step 2: Set Up Facebook Ads Manager

Facebook Ads Manager is the platform where you create and manage all your campaigns. Go to business.facebook.com and create a Business Manager account. Connect your Business Page, add your payment method (Visa or Mastercard card), and you are ready to create your first campaign.

Step 3: Choose Your Campaign Objective

Facebook organizes campaigns around objectives. For most Cameroonian small businesses starting out, these are the most useful: Traffic (send people to your website or WhatsApp), Leads (collect contact information from potential customers), Engagement (get more likes, comments, and shares on your posts), and Messages (get people to send you a direct message on WhatsApp or Messenger).

Step 4: Define Your Audience

This is the most important step. Under Audience, set your Location to Cameroon or specific cities like Douala or Yaoundé. Set the Age range that matches your target customer. Choose relevant Interests based on what your ideal customer likes and follows. You can also exclude certain audiences to avoid wasting budget.

Step 5: Set Your Budget

Facebook Ads work with a daily budget or a lifetime budget. For beginners in Cameroon, start with a daily budget of 2,000 to 5,000 FCFA. This is enough to get data and see what works before scaling up. Do not start with a large budget until you have tested and found what performs well.

Step 6: Create Your Ad

Choose your ad format: single image, video, carousel (multiple images), or collection. Write a compelling headline and body text. Your image or video must be high quality and eye-catching. Always include a clear call to action: Contact Us, Shop Now, Learn More, or Send Message.

For Cameroonian audiences, ads in French tend to reach a wider audience. Consider creating separate ad sets for French and English speakers.

Step 7: Review and Launch

Before publishing, review everything — your audience targeting, budget, ad creative, and destination URL or WhatsApp link. Once satisfied, click Publish. Facebook will review your ad (usually within a few hours) before it goes live.

Step 8: Monitor and Optimize

Check your campaign performance daily for the first week. Key metrics to watch: reach (how many people saw your ad), clicks (how many clicked), and cost per result (how much each click or lead costs). Pause ads that are not performing and increase budget on those that are.
